For the supplied run_id and exact assigned IDs, prepare the candidate batch with exactly char_tfidf, construction_token_tfidf, word_tfidf, bm25_token, and char_word_fusion, each k=5, using fusion exactly rrf. Review every disagreement ID semantically before persistence. Compare all shortlisted candidates on primary operation, physical object, and scope/detail, favoring a specific operation-object match over generic lexical overlap; fused rank is only a tie-breaker. For each reviewed item select exactly three distinct supplied artifact-local candidate_index values in final rank order.

Before durable persistence, confirm internally that the authoritative partition is disjoint and covers all assigned IDs, every review ID has exactly one successful evidence result and a concrete three-distinct-index decision, and every fallback ID has concrete valid ranked predictions from the server-side fused top-three fallback. Return immediately with a compact completion report containing the artifact_id, counts/IDs of reviewed and fallback items, and confirmation that both complementary durable paths succeeded. If there are no IDs in one partition, use only the required durable path for the nonempty partition, provided the tool contract permits it, and state that compactly.
